description: Implementation of a digital signer using BouncyCastle library for PDF signatures, including methods for generating signatures, selecting digest algorithms, and handling certificates.

classes.name: BouncyCastleSigner
classes.description: A class implementing IDigitalSigner that uses BouncyCastle to create PDF digital signatures, supporting various digest algorithms and certificate types.

methods.name: GetSignatureSizeAsync
methods.description: Calculates and returns the size of the signature asynchronously.

methods.name: GetSignatureAsync
methods.description: Generates a digital signature for the provided stream using BouncyCastle CMS.

methods.name: GetProperDigestAlgorithm
methods.description: Selects the appropriate digest algorithm based on PDF version or specified digest type.

methods.name: GetAsymmetricAlgorithm
methods.description: Returns the appropriate asymmetric algorithm (RSA, DSA, ECDSA) based on the certificate's public key OID.
